values.note: DCNR state forest motorized campsite rate (a state forest program, not a state park one). The $6.50 reservation fee is non-refundable and charged once per booking.

fees.source: ReserveAmerica showed no price breakdown for this site on 2026-11-10 although its calendar offers the nights; the rate is the one DCNR publishes for every state forest motorized site: $10.00 a night for PA residents, $15.00 for non-residents, 'Additional taxes and fees may apply'. The $6.50 reservation fee is the one the engine quotes on the other state forest sites read the same day. https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/overnight-prices-and-policies ('Motorized roadside, hike-in roadside, equestrian, and rustic campsites can be reserved for a fee of $10.00 a night for Pennsylvania residents and $15.00 a night for non-residents ... effective as of November 3, 2022'); Michaux camping brochure, elibrary.dcnr.pa.gov docId 3562328 ('DCNR charges a $6.50 non-refundable transaction fee on all reservations and registrations')

note: A small gravel pad in open hardwoods at the end of its own narrow gravel spur, about 55 m off Flat Ridge Road, with a picnic table and a fire ring with grill. DCNR's Edgemere map classes it 'Small Trailer, RV, Tent', the smaller of its two classes, and the listed pad is only 45 ft by 35 ft: a rig has to back the length of the single-lane spur or turn on the pad, and overhead clearance is posted at 15 ft. The ground is level. Flat Ridge Road is an unpaved forest road, 1.1 miles north from Bushkill Falls Road (3 miles south from Silver Lake Road). No toilet; pack out trash. State forest roads get no winter maintenance and are not plowed. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: still listed and bookable online (10 of 14 nights already reserved in the November 2026 window; May and July 2027 open), Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle length 30 ft, back-in, gravel, slight grade, 175-ft driveway; no site-specific warning text beyond the location line. Booking, hookups, season confirmed; pull_through set false; toilets/water written as none; reservation fee added. Ground: the Esri frame is too dark under conifer shade to read; a leaf-off NAIP frame shows a single-lane spur about 55 m long ending in a pad roughly 10 m across, pin about 8 m from it (not moved). 3DEP: level within half a metre for 40 m around. NHD: no water within 200 m. Phone 570-895-4000 confirmed on the DCNR and ReserveAmerica pages.
flags: Thin margin, not a drop: max vehicle length 30 ft on a 45 x 35 ft pad that DCNR classes 'Small Trailer, RV, Tent' (Edgemere map; the DCNR GIS layer notes the same). The page lists RV Site and nothing excludes RVs, so a 23-ft rig is inside the limit; the tight spur and pad are in the note.

Fee not quoted by the engine: ReserveAmerica showed no price breakdown for this site (price 0.0 in the page data) on any date tried though the calendar sells the nights. The $10/$15 rate is from DCNR's prices page and the $6.50 reservation fee from the other state forest site pages read today; the cart needs a login and was not opened.

Forest-wide wording, not site-specific: the Delaware camping page says 'many are accessible by sedan/car while others are better accessed by four-wheel drive vehicles'. Nothing on the E012 page or map singles this site out, so it is treated as silent.
